name: DeformableCohesiveElement
description: Tetrahedral Deformable Element Composed of Nodes

attributes.name: nodepairs
attributes.description: Ids and relative position+orientation difference of members of the cohesive deformable element in the inital condition (should not be accessed directly)

attributes.name: localmap
attributes.description: Ids and relative positions+orientations of members of the deformable element (should not be accessed directly)

attributes.name: faces
attributes.description: Faces of the element for drawing

attributes.name: wire
attributes.description: Whether this Shape is rendered using color surfaces, or only wireframe (can still be overridden by global config of the renderer).

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.description: Whether this Shape will be highlighted when rendered.

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: addPair
methods.description: Add a node shared_pt<:yref:'Body'>& as into the element

methods.name: removePair
methods.description: Add a node shared_pt<:yref:'Body'>& as into the element

methods.name: addNode
methods.description: Add a node shared_pt<:yref:'Body'>& as into the element

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Get a node shared_pt<:yref:'Body'>& as into the element

methods.name: delNode
methods.description: Remove a node shared_pt<:yref:'Body'>& from the element

methods.name: addFace
methods.description: Add a face into the element

methods.name: removeLastFace
methods.description: Remove a face from the element

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
